# ckbtools

`ckbtools` provides tools for statistical analyses in epidemiology.

It is developed by [China Kadoorie Biobank](http://www.ckbiobank.org)
researchers for users of CKB data and other researchers in epidemiology.

Features of the package include:

- Standardised incidence rates
- Age-at-risk expansion
- Variance of the log risk
- Trend and heterogeneity tests
- Preparation of CKB proteomics data
- Regression model helper functions

## Installation

Install the latest version of `ckbtools` from the ckbiobank R-universe:

``` r

install.packages('ckbtools',
                 repos = c('https://ckbiobank.r-universe.dev/', getOption('repos')))
```

This will also install required dependencies using your existing package
repositories.

## Get started

Read
[`vignette("ckbtools")`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/articles/ckbtools.md)
to get started.

## Citation

If you find this package useful, please cite as:

China Kadoorie Biobank Collaborative Group (2026). “ckbtools: Tools for
analyses in epidemiology.” <https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools>.

## Development and support

This package is under development and will be updated with bug fixes and
additional functions related to statistical analyses in epidemiology.
Please refer to the package documentation for guidance on usage and use
GitHub issues to report bugs. This package is provided “as is” for
research purposes, without warranty of any kind. The authors accept no
liability for its use or for any results derived from it.

# Package index

## Observational epidemiology

- [`incidence_rates()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/incidence_rates.md)
  : Calculate standardised incidence rates
- [`expand_age_at_risk()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/expand_age_at_risk.md)
  : Lexis expansion of data by age-at-risk
- [`heterogeneity()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/heterogeneity.md)
  : Test for heterogeneity
- [`trend()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/trend.md) :
  Test for trend

## Regression modelling

- [`linear_model()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/linear_model.md)
  : Estimate the association between an exposure and a continuous
  outcome
- [`logistic_model()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/logistic_model.md)
  : Estimate the association between an exposure and a binary outcome
- [`cox_model()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/cox_model.md)
  : Estimate the association between an exposure and incident disease
- [`linear_model_safely()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/safemodels.md)
  [`logistic_model_safely()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/safemodels.md)
  [`cox_model_safely()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/safemodels.md)
  : Safe versions of regression model function
- [`multiple_models()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/multiple_models.md)
  : Multiple linear, logistic or Cox proportional hazards regression
  models

## Proteomics data

- [`prepare_olink_meta_data()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/prepare_olink_meta_data.md)
  : Preparation of Olink meta data
- [`prepare_somascan_meta_data()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/prepare_somascan_meta_data.md)
  : Preparation of SomaScan meta data
- [`prepare_olink_data()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/prepare_olink_data.md)
  : Preparation of Olink protein data
- [`prepare_somascan_data()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/prepare_somascan_data.md)
  : Prepare SomaScan protein data
- [`prepare_proteomics_analysis_dataset()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/prepare_proteomics_analysis_dataset.md)
  : Preparation of a proteomics analysis data set
- [`summarise_continuous()`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/summarise_continuous.md)
  : Summarise continuous variables

## Data

- [`ckbtools_baseline`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/ckbtools_baseline.md)
  : Synthetic CKB baseline data for demoing functions
- [`ckbtools_endpoints`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/ckbtools_endpoints.md)
  : Synthetic CKB endpoint data for demoing functions
- [`ckbtools_endpoint_definitions`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/ckbtools_endpoint_definitions.md)
  : Synthetic CKB endpoint definitions data for demoing functions
- [`ckbtools_ascertainments`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/ckbtools_ascertainments.md)
  : Synthetic CKB ascertainment data for demoing functions
- [`ckbtools_raw_olink_meta_data`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/ckbtools_raw_olink_meta_data.md)
  : Synthetic CKB Olink proteomics data for demoing functions
- [`ckbtools_raw_olink_protein_data`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/ckbtools_raw_olink_protein_data.md)
  : Synthetic CKB Olink proteomics data for demoing functions
- [`ckbtools_raw_somascan_meta_data`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/ckbtools_raw_somascan_meta_data.md)
  : Synthetic CKB SomaScan proteomics data for demoing functions
- [`ckbtools_raw_somascan_protein_data`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/ckbtools_raw_somascan_protein_data.md)
  : Synthetic CKB SomaScan proteomics data for demoing functions
- [`ckbtools_raw_somascan_sample_data`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/ckbtools_raw_somascan_sample_data.md)
  : Synthetic CKB SomaScan proteomics data for demoing functions
- [`ckbtools_participant_data`](https://ckbiobank.github.io/ckbtools/reference/ckbtools_participant_data.md)
  : Synthetic CKB participant data for demoing functions
